summary: Icon library of 60,000+ icons in 10 styles; 6,000+ free MIT-licensed stroke icons, paid plans add all styles and formats.
description: A hand-crafted icon library of 60,000+ icons in 10 styles (stroke, solid, twotone, duotone and bulk in rounded, standard and sharp variants) across 59 categories. Shipped as SVG, icon font, Figma library and plugin, and packages for React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, SolidJS, React Native, Flutter, WordPress and Webflow. The free tier covers 6,000+ stroke-rounded icons; Pro adds the full set, AI-powered search and custom icon upload.
